Anyone can ask to see, update or delete the information held about them.

i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_account_security:
If you create an account, please keep your login details secure.
You are responsible for activity on your account unless you let us know about misuse or a security problem.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_education_only: This app is an education tool to support learning and revision. It is not formal academic, legal or professional advice and cannot guarantee exam passes, grades or any particular outcome. Study choices and decisions remain the user's responsibility.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_how_we_use_data:
This data helps to tailor the app to each person's goals, understand how the app is used and improve features over time. It may also be used to get in touch about important changes to the app or an account.
Personal data is never sold.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_identity_check: Identity may need to be confirmed before a request is completed. If any information must be kept for legal or security reasons, this will be explained.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_minimum_data: Only information needed to run and improve the service is collected.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_service_limits: The aim is to keep the app helpful and reliable, but no service is perfect. Continuous availability or complete freedom from errors cannot be promised, and the app may not suit every situation.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_storage: Information is stored on a managed server and database provided by Railway. Railway provides the hosting and infrastructure; we control how data is used within the app and keep it only for as long as reasonably needed.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_third_party: We rely on trusted third-party services, such as hosting providers, to run the app. These services only process data as needed to provide the infrastructure and do not have permission to use it for their own purposes.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_uk_law_limits: As far as UK law allows, we are not responsible for losses such as missed marks, lost income or opportunities that arise from using, or being unable to use, the app. Nothing here removes any rights provided by UK law.

i18nExtra.visualsystem_controls_hint: Wheel: next/prev | up/down: next/prev | Space: replay
i18nExtra.visualsystem_step0:
The eyes collect light
from the world and turn
this into signals for the brain
to create 'vision'.
i18nExtra.visualsystem_step1:
Light is focused onto
the back of the eye
by the cornea and lens.
i18nExtra.visualsystem_step2:
At the back of the eye
is the retina.
i18nExtra.visualsystem_step3:
This is like a sensor or film
in a camera which turns the
light into electrical signals
that are passed to the brain
down the optic nerve.

The brain then creates
vision from these signals.
